configurations.name: wrangler-dev
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && npx wrangler dev --port 8787

configurations.name: wrangler-dev-promptlog
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && npx wrangler dev --port 8788 --var PROMPT_LOG_ENABLED:true

configurations.name: wrangler-dev-guardrail-admins
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && npx wrangler dev --port 8789 --var GUARDRAIL_ADMIN_EMAILS:admin@example.com
